notes.title: Maintenance Schedule Changes for Sep-Oct 2018
notes.notes:
Hello, imcGAMES here.

We would like to announce a change in the scheduled maintenance dates for the last week of September and first week of October, 2018.

For those two weeks, maintenance will be carried out not on Wednesday as is usual, but on Thursday. Therefore, you can expect maintenance to take place on September 27 and October 4, respectively. Any procedure that takes place during the maintenance will also be adjusted to that schedule.

After the first week of October, our maintenance schedule is expected to return to normal, i.e. every Wednesday, unless stated otherwise.

Thank you.

notes.title: Castilla Mission and Character Card Issues: Update
notes.notes:
Hello,
imcGAMES here.

We would like to make know that we have fixed the following issues:

1) "Chaos Phobitian General" missing from the Castilla Mine mission.
2) Character occasionally not being generated when using certain event Character Cards.

These issues were patched today, April 27, 2018, at around SGT 10:00. If you haven't yet, you may need to restart your client to apply the new patch.

Thank you for your understanding. Kindly let us know via Support ticket if you are encountering any other issues in-game.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Known Issues: November 15, 2017
notes.notes:
Hello,
imcGAMES here.

We are currently aware of the following issues. We will keep you updated on further procedures.

1. Incorrect item name displayed for Lyndon Box reward [FIXED]

- Blood Navy Cano Cards obtained as rewards from Lyndon Boxes have been reported to display under the name of "Gold Package - Blood Navy Cano Cards". 
- Please be informed that the correct item to be obtained from the Lyndon Box is "Blood Navy Cano Card".

This issue has been solved now. Please remember to restart your game in order to apply the fixes. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

2. Lyndon Box rewards unable to be retrieved from Cabinet

- The set of three "Sacred Sedecram Pass - 7 days" obtained from Lyndon Boxes cannot currently be retrieved from the Cabinet.
- We are currently preparing to fix this issue and will update this announcement once it is solved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

Thank you.
imcGAMES
 
Let us know via Support Ticket if you are experiencing other problems. When reporting issues, please be as detailed as possible. Screenshots in-game details and timestamps would be greatly appreciated. The more information we have on a specific issue, the quicker it will be resolved.

notes.title: Hotfix Notice - November 10, 2017
notes.notes:
Hello,
imcGAMES here.

We will be fixing the following issue via Hotfix on November 10, 2017.

Please note that you will need to [b][i]restart[/i] the Granado Espada for SEA client[/b] in order for the patch to be applied.

[b]1. [EVENT] The GM’s Request Event rewards[/b]
- In order to fix the issue with only 1 * Refined Vespanola Weapon Coupon (30 Days) being given for the 1-time clear reward, we will be providing [b][i]2 EXTRA[/i] Refined Vespanola Weapon Coupons (30 Days) for the [i]5-time clear rewards.[/i][/b]

Our apologies for the inconvenience. 

Thank you. 
imcGAMES
